envelopeSource: production onsetEnvelope imported read-only; WIN=256 HOP=11 and bias=3*WIN/4/sampleRate, exactly as v558
peakPicking: Frozen v558 normalized threshold 0.02, 5 ms suppression radius, parabolic interpolation; export all full peak times without labels
oldCandidateParity: All 90 nearest-to-old-target fullResidualMs values must exactly equal v558 before diagnostic analysis
population: All 29 clear+approximate objects in sample-032/sample-002, with the 13 E10-incorrect objects as the main subset
categoriesInPriorityOrder: correctPeakSelectedByOldTarget: nearest full peak to actual is within 5 ms and exactly equals the old target-selected full peak
correctPeakReachableButNotSelected: nearest full peak to actual is within 5 ms and inside old target +/-10 ms, but another peak was selected
correctPeakOutsideOldTargetWindow: nearest full peak to actual is within 5 ms but outside old target +/-10 ms
nearbyPeakButOutside5ms: nearest full peak within 20 ms exists but is more than 5 ms from actual
noFullPeakWithin20ms: no full peak within actual +/-20 ms
nearestRule: Nearest full peak to annotated actual within +/-20 ms; ties by smaller absolute distance then smaller peak time
oracleBounds: Add only E10-incorrect weight in correctPeakOutsideOldTargetWindow to current overall correct weight
Add E10-incorrect weight in all three correct-peak categories to current overall correct weight
Both are label-centered upper bounds, not deployable candidates or measured system improvements

hypotheses.H1: Full peaks within 5 ms of actual exist for at least 50% of E10-incorrect audible weight in sample-032/sample-002
hypotheses.H2: Oracle recovery of every E10-incorrect object with a correct full peak can raise the three-song overall audible correct rate to at least 80%
hypotheses.H3: Peak export matches all 90 frozen full candidates and every diagnostic row/category/bound can be independently reconstructed

testPolicy: Diagnostic only; no peak parameter sweep, new selection algorithm, production code change or confirmation-set access
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
